name: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2
description: NIST SP 800-171 — Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations. Required for DoD contractors and federal supply chain.

controls.title: Authorized Access Control
controls.description: Limit system access to authorized users, processes acting on behalf of authorized users, and devices (including other systems).

controls.title: Transaction and Function Control
controls.description: Limit system access to the types of transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute.

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.description: Employ the principle of least privilege, including for specific security functions and privileged accounts.

controls.title: Remote Access Monitoring
controls.description: Monitor and control remote access sessions.

controls.title: Remote Access Cryptography
controls.description: Employ cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote access sessions.

controls.title: Role-Based Risk Awareness
controls.description: Ensure that managers, systems administrators, and users of organizational systems are made aware of the security risks associated with their activities.

controls.title: System Auditing
controls.description: Create and retain system audit logs and records to the extent needed to enable the monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized system activity.

controls.title: User Actions Accountability
controls.description: Ensure that the actions of individual system users can be traced to those users so they can be held accountable for their actions.

controls.title: Baseline Configurations
controls.description: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and inventories of organizational systems throughout the respective system development life cycles.

controls.title: Security Configuration Enforcement
controls.description: Establish and enforce security configuration settings for information technology products employed in organizational systems.

controls.title: Multi-factor Authentication
controls.description: Use multi-factor authentication for local and network access to privileged accounts and for network access to non-privileged accounts.

controls.title: Incident Handling Capability
controls.description: Establish an operational incident-handling capability for organizational systems that includes preparation, detection, analysis, containment, recovery, and user response activities.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: Periodically assess the risk to organizational operations, organizational assets, and individuals, resulting from the operation of organizational systems.

controls.title: Vulnerability Scanning
controls.description: Scan for vulnerabilities in organizational systems and applications periodically and when new vulnerabilities affecting those systems and applications are identified.

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.description: Monitor, control, and protect organizational communications at the external boundaries and key internal boundaries of organizational systems.

controls.title: Data in Transit Encryption
controls.description: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure of CUI during transmission unless otherwise protected by alternative physical safeguards.

controls.title: Cryptographic Key Management
controls.description: Establish and manage cryptographic keys when cryptography is employed within organizational systems.

controls.title: Flaw Remediation
controls.description: Identify, report, and correct information and information system flaws in a timely manner.

controls.title: Security Monitoring
controls.description: Monitor organizational systems, including inbound and outbound communications traffic, to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks.
